summary: The proof establishes the stated uniform mixed-row price for a strong field on any one child block, including arbitrary depth. The avoidance and entry classes are disjoint and preserve that block; the original normalizer is fully bounded, while the entry cylinder factors are retained exactly. The ancestor-block cubic gain, scalar capacity estimate, row-score variance bounds, fixed-support compactness argument, and heterogeneous-product comparison all have the required hypotheses and normalizations. The root case, small-k cases, final-level entry case, and unrestricted height tilts are covered. No mathematical error or gap was found.
